name: Bipole III
description: HVDC line from Keewatinohk to Riel on a west-side route.
regulatory_notes: Commission hearings October to November 2012, with sessions in Winnipeg, Gillam, Thompson, The Pas, Dauphin, Portage la Prairie and Niverville, plus a route-adjustment session in March 2013. Report June 2013.

name: Manitoba–Minnesota Transmission Project
description: 500 kV line from Dorsey to the US border near Piney.
regulatory_notes: Commission hearings May to June 2017 at the convention centre in Winnipeg; report to the National Energy Board in October 2017.

name: Kivalliq Hydro-Fibre Link
description: About 1,200 km, 150 MW plus fibre, from the Gillam area to five Kivalliq communities in Nunavut and two mines. Cost estimates have risen from $1.6B to $3.39B.
regulatory_notes: Pre-development. Manitoba Hydro has reserved 50 MW and a transmission service request has been filed. No Manitoba Environment Act filing or federal impact assessment file was found. Fox Lake Cree Nation signed a memorandum with the Kivalliq Inuit Association in 2021 but conditions its support on mitigation and benefits. Sources disagree on whether the Manitoba origin is Keewatinohk, the Gillam area, or near Churchill.

name: Hudson Bay Railway
description: The Pas to Churchill. Carries Snow Lake zinc concentrate to tidewater.
regulatory_notes: Owned by Arctic Gateway Group. Part of the Port of Churchill Plus referral to the federal Major Projects Office.

name: PTH 6 corridor
description: Winnipeg to Thompson. The main mining supply road; passes the Minago site.

name: PR 391
description: Thompson to Leaf Rapids and Lynn Lake. Being upgraded for the Lynn Lake gold project.

name: PR 304
description: Pine Falls to Hollow Water and Bissett. Haul route for Wanipigow sand and True North gold.
